name: How long does exterior window trim repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does exterior window trim repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of exterior window trim repair varies depending on the extent of the damage, the number of windows, and the materials involved. Minor repairs might take a few hours per window, while more extensive rot or replacement projects could span several days. We provide a detailed project timeline after an initial on-site assessment to give you a clear expectation of the work involved.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies based on damage extent and number of windows; minor repairs take hours, extensive projects can take days.
